author: TuckerCarlson
text:
Technology is progressing faster than ever and yet the population isn’t thriving. In fact, just the opposite. That's why we need to return to the truths that bring meaning to our lives.

Our friend Sean Stone just wrote a book about that. It's called “Ten Things to Learn: Ancient Wisdom for the Modern Soul.” Get it now at http://TuckerCarlsonBooks.com.
